powers.action_summary: Accept and hold the voluntarily surrendered license of a dentist or pharmacist with a drug or alcohol abuse problem, or make another disposition of it, if public health and safety will be adequately protected.
powers.quote: which may accept and hold such license or make any other disposition regarding such license deemed appropriate under the circumstances, if the department determines the health and safety of the public will be adequately protected thereby

powers.action_summary: Accept the surrender of a license after agreement to conditions for restoration, or treat the license as not surrendered and impose conditions allowing the licensee to retain it.
powers.quote: The department may accept the surrender of such license after agreement to conditions to be met prior to the restoration of the license or the department may treat the license as not surrendered and may impose conditions to allow the licensee to retain the license.
powers.law_title: Provides for temporary surrender of the license of a dentist or pharmacist with a drug or alcohol abuse problem, or such other disposition as determined by the department of education

powers.action_summary: Waive or alter the wage notice requirements for temporary help firms.
powers.quote: The commissioner shall have discretion to waive or alter requirements of paragraph (a) of This subdivision for temporary help firms as defined in section nine hundred sixteen of This chapter.
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Take assignments of wage claims under the labor law chapter from employees or third parties in trust for the employees.
powers.quote: He or she may take assignments of claims for wages under this chapter from employees or third parties in trust for such employees
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Institute proceedings on criminal violations of articles 6, 5, 7, 19 and 19-A of the labor law.
powers.quote: He or she may institute proceedings on account of any criminal violation of any provision of This article, or article five, seven, nineteen or nineteen-a of this chapter.
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Require an employer convicted of a violation, or with an unsatisfied order to comply, to deposit a bond.
powers.quote: the commissioner may require such employer to deposit with him or her a bond in such sum as he or she may deem sufficient and adequate in the circumstances
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Require an employer with an unsatisfied order to comply to provide an accounting of its assets.
powers.quote: the commissioner may require the employer to provide an accounting of assets of the employer, including but not limited to, a list of all bank accounts, accounts receivable, personal property, real property, automobiles or other vehicles, and Any other assets
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Sue in supreme court to compel an employer to furnish the accounting of assets and pay a civil penalty of up to $10,000.
powers.quote: the commissioner may bring an action in the name and on behalf of the people of the state of new york against such employer in the supreme court to compel such employer to furnish the accounting and pay a civil penalty of no more than ten thousand dollars.
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Recover the $500 civil penalty in any legal action necessary, including administrative action.
powers.quote: shall forfeit to the people of the state the sum of five hundred dollars for each such failure, to be recovered by the commissioner in Any legal action necessary, including administrative action or a civil action.
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Bring legal action to collect a claim for an employee not given a wage statement and assess damages of $100 for each work week of violation.
powers.quote: the commissioner may assess against the employer damages of one hundred dollars for each work week that the violations occurred or continue to occur.
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Assess a civil penalty of $1,000 to $10,000 on an employer or person found to have retaliated against an employee.
powers.quote: the commissioner may, by an order which shall describe particularly the nature of the violation, assess the employer or person a civil penalty of not less than one thousand nor more than ten thousand dollars
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Order all appropriate relief for retaliation, including enjoining the conduct, liquidated damages, reinstatement and lost compensation.
powers.quote: The commissioner may also order all appropriate relief including enjoining the conduct of Any person or employer; Ordering payment of liquidated damages
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Assess liquidated damages on behalf of every employee aggrieved by retaliation.
powers.quote: The commissioner may assess liquidated damages on behalf of Every employee aggrieved under This section, in addition to Any other remedies permitted by This section.
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Include in an order to comply an automatic fifteen percent additional damages amount due ninety days after the order becomes final.
powers.quote: At the discretion of the commissioner, the commissioner shall have full authority to provide for inclusion of an automatic fifteen percent additional amount of damages to come due and owing upon expiration of ninety days from an order to comply becoming final.
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Assign to an employee the wages, interest or liquidated damages due and file an order in the employee's name with the county clerk.
powers.quote: the commissioner may assign that portion of the money due that constitutes wages, wage supplements, interest on wages or wage supplements, or liquidated damages due that employee, to that employee and file an order in that amount in the name of that employee with the county clerk
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Assign to an employee the wages, interest or liquidated damages due and file an order in the employee's name with the county clerk.
powers.quote: the commissioner may assign that portion of the money due that constitutes wages, wage supplements, interest on wages or wage supplements, or liquidated damages due the employee, to that employee and file an order in that amount in the name of such employee with the county clerk
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act

powers.action_summary: Post or affix, for up to ninety days, a notice visible to the general public of a willful failure to pay all wages.
powers.quote: Where the violation is for a willful failure to pay all wages as required by article six, nineteen, or nineteen-a of This chapter, to post and/or affix for a period not to exceed ninety days in an area visible to the general public, as ordered by the commissioner, a notice
powers.law_title: Establishes the wage theft prevention act
